title: Account Manager - Soluções de Cibersegurança
description:
1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B focada no fornecimento de soluções integradas e produtos profissionais para projetos de infraestrutura e indústria.

Não atuamos apenas como uma plataforma tradicional de fornecimento de produtos. Damos grande importância à segurança, praticidade e adequação de sistemas e equipamentos utilizados em projetos reais, sempre considerando as necessidades de operação de longo prazo.

Na visão da SolutionMall, a cibersegurança não se limita a uma única categoria de software. Ela é um requisito essencial em sistemas, dispositivos conectados e na lógica geral de implantação de projetos. Mesmo em equipamentos básicos, valorizamos protocolos de comunicação segura, gestão de senhas, controle de acesso e proteção de privacidade. Acreditamos que a segurança deve ser incorporada desde o início no desenho do sistema, na seleção de produtos e na lógica de implementação.

Para sustentar esse princípio, a SolutionMall também dá atenção especial à verificação de cibersegurança e aos padrões de segurança em nível de dispositivo antes que os produtos sejam incorporados às soluções de projeto.

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Negócios – Soluções de Cibersegurança para apoiar a expansão da atuação da SolutionMall no Brasil .

Esta é uma função part-time, baseada em cooperação . Procuramos alguém que possa trabalhar de forma flexível com a SolutionMall para apoiar:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionados à cibersegurança
  • comunicação com clientes e educação de mercado
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • promoção de conceitos de soluções orientadas à segurança
  • coordenação entre as necessidades do cliente e a direção técnica da SolutionMall

Esta posição não é destinada a um pesquisador acadêmico de segurança pura, e também não é uma vaga tradicional de vendas em tempo integral. Procuramos alguém que compreenda o valor prático da cibersegurança em sistemas reais e consiga impulsionar tanto a conscientização dos clientes quanto as oportunidades de negócio.

A função combina principalmente:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionados à cibersegurança
  • promoção de soluções e conceitos
  • comunicação com clientes e parceiros
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • comunicação técnico-comercial básica sobre segurança
  • cooperação no desenvolvimento de mercado de longo prazo

3) Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Expansão de Mercado

  • Desenvolver oportunidades comerciais relacionadas a soluções de cibersegurança, sistemas com foco em segurança e requisitos de projeto orientados à segurança
  • Promover a abordagem da SolutionMall voltada à segurança em projetos de infraestrutura, indústria e sistemas conectados
  • Identificar clientes em potencial, parceiros, consultores, integradores e demais stakeholders de projetos que valorizem cibersegurança e proteção de privacidade
  • Ajudar a ampliar a percepção do mercado de que a cibersegurança deve ser um requisito padrão na seleção e implantação de sistemas

Comunicação com Clientes e Promoção do Conceito de Segurança

  • Comunicar aos clientes a importância prática da cibersegurança em sistemas e equipamentos conectados
  • Ajudar a explicar por que requisitos relacionados à segurança são importantes, incluindo:
  • suporte a HTTPS
  • evitar senhas simples, padrão ou fracas
  • configuração de senhas definidas pelo usuário
  • controle de permissões
  • proteção de privacidade
  • Apoiar a SolutionMall na promoção de uma mentalidade mais forte de segurança em projetos nos quais a cibersegurança ainda não seja totalmente priorizada

Acompanhamento de Oportunidades de Projeto

  • Acompanhar necessidades de clientes e oportunidades de projeto relacionadas a aplicações sensíveis à segurança
  • Ajudar a identificar em quais cenários a cibersegurança pode se tornar um fator importante na tomada de decisão do projeto
  • Apoiar discussões de projeto em que sejam relevantes seleção segura de produtos, controle de acesso ao sistema e requisitos ligados à privacidade
  • Auxiliar na conversão do interesse do cliente em discussões comerciais práticas e oportunidades concretas de projeto

Coordenação Técnica e de Soluções

  • Manter uma compreensão prática das expectativas básicas de cibersegurança para sistemas e equipamentos conectados
  • Apoiar a comunicação entre clientes e equipes da SolutionMall em relação ao posicionamento de produtos com foco em segurança
  • Ajudar a alinhar as necessidades dos clientes com a direção de soluções orientadas à segurança da SolutionMall
  • Auxiliar na apresentação da cibersegurança não apenas como um tema de conformidade, mas também como um requisito de confiança e operação de longo prazo

Relacionamento com Parceiros e Feedback de Mercado

  • Construir relacionamentos com clientes locais, parceiros de canal, consultores e stakeholders técnicos
  • Compartilhar feedback de mercado sobre conscientização dos clientes, preocupações com segurança, tendências de projeto e expectativas relacionadas à privacidade
  • Ajudar a SolutionMall a aprimorar sua abordagem comercial e sua estratégia de comunicação em oportunidades relacionadas à cibersegurança no mercado brasileiro

4) Qualificações

Requisitos

  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:
  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionado à cibersegurança
  • vendas de soluções de segurança
  • negócios em infraestrutura de TI ou soluções de sistemas
  • coordenação técnico-comercial
  • desenvolvimento de projetos em setores sensíveis à segurança
  • Conhecimento básico de conceitos práticos de cibersegurança, como:
  • HTTPS / comunicação segura
  • segurança de senhas
  • controle de permissões
  • proteção de privacidade
  • requisitos de segurança em nível de dispositivo ou sistema
  • Capacidade de comunicar tanto o valor comercial quanto o significado técnico prático dos requisitos de cibersegurança
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação e desenvolvimento de negócios
  • Conforto para trabalhar em uma função part-time, flexível e orientada à cooperação
  • Proficiência de trabalho em inglês

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na promoção de conceitos de cibersegurança em projetos de infraestrutura, indústria, IoT ou sistemas conectados
  • Experiência com clientes que exigem maior atenção à segurança, privacidade ou conformidade
  • Familiaridade com dispositivos conectados, plataformas de monitoramento, sistemas inteligentes ou equipamentos em rede
  • Capacidade de apoiar tanto o desenvolvimento de negócios quanto o acompanhamento prático de projetos
  • Português é altamente desejável, e outros idiomas locais ou regionais podem ser uma vantagem adicional

5) Cobertura

Esta função apoia o desenvolvimento de negócios da SolutionMall em cibersegurança no Brasil .

Dependendo das oportunidades de projeto e das prioridades de mercado, o profissional selecionado poderá apoiar:

  • desenvolvimento de clientes
  • promoção de conceitos de segurança
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • coordenação com parceiros
  • comunicação comercial relacionada a projetos

em mercados nos quais a conscientização sobre cibersegurança esteja se tornando cada vez mais importante para sistemas conectados e soluções de infraestrutura.

6) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta é uma função part-time sob um modelo baseado em cooperação .

Buscamos alguém que possa trabalhar com a SolutionMall de forma contínua e contribuir por meio de:

  • desenvolvimento de mercado em cibersegurança
  • acompanhamento de clientes e parceiros
  • desenvolvimento de oportunidades relacionadas à segurança
  • comunicação técnico-comercial
  • suporte à coordenação de projetos

Esta função foi desenhada para uma cooperação prática e flexível, e não para uma estrutura tradicional de trabalho integral em escritório.

7) Remuneração

A remuneração é baseada em desempenho e vinculada à contribuição real, incluindo:

  • resultados de desenvolvimento de negócios
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • desenvolvimento de clientes
  • promoção de mercado relacionada à segurança
  • resultados comerciais e de projeto

A estrutura detalhada será compartilhada com os candidatos selecionados.

8) Como se Candidatar

Opção 1

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

Time Commitment - 5-6 hours per day


About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Assess outputs for:
  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)
  • Strong understanding of grammar, syntax, and semantics
  • Ability to adopt different voices and points of view
  • Creative thinking
  • Strong attentive to detail
  • Well-honed internet research skills

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.


With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.


Requirements

  • 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience).
  • Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus.
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

description:

E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.

  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

What’s in It for You?

Career Development

Making an Impact

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking a contractor to provide day-to-day remote support for an ageing 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment supporting HPC clusters within a data center setting. The engagement is focused on operational support, incident resolution, system health monitoring, filesystem support, and critical escalation coverage outside standard business hours. The IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer will be responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the storage environment. This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues.

Brazil, Mexico

  • Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment

  • Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to work during EST business hours

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.

Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.

Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes

A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.

title: Senior closer
description:
The Differs Company
A The Differs Company ajuda criadores, marcas e empreendedores a se destacarem no digital através de posicionamento estratégico, branding e conteúdos de alto impacto.
Nosso ecossistema inclui mentorias, cursos, consultorias e suporte para crescimento real de negócios, sempre orientado a resultados concretos. Trabalhamos diretamente com o perfil no Instagram, cuja audiência engajada soma centenas de milhares de seguidores, oferecendo oportunidades de venda tanto B2 C quanto B2 B.
Descrição da vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a) closer para trabalhar 100% remotamente, com experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas, que saiba conduzir leads do primeiro contato até o fechamento, sem desistir no meio do caminho.
Você será responsável por:
Conduzir calls estratégicas com leads qualificados
Diagnosticar o cenário do cliente e propor soluções de alto valor
Fechar vendas de mentorias, produtos digitais e consultorias B2 B
Lidar com objeções de forma madura e estratégica
Manter registro completo das interações em CRM Oportunidade de crescimento: quem performar acima da média poderá atuar em vendas B2 B de tickets mais altos e consultorias estratégicas.
Qualificações
Experiência comprovada como closer e em vendas consultivas
Capacidade de sustentar a negociação até o fechamento
Perfil persistente, estratégico e orientado a resultados
Habilidade de lidar com objeções complexas
Diferencial: experiência em vendas de mentorias ou produtos de alto valor
Comunicação clara e assertiva, com repertório para conversar com clientes exigentes
Excelente em gramática da Língua Portuguesa Como se candidatar
Envie via inbox:
Um breve texto de apresentação
Uma gravação real de call de vendas para análise Se você sabe fechar vendas de forma consistente e quer crescer em um ambiente de alta performance, essa é sua oportunidade.

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias: Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/Postgres
Visão geral da posição
Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.
Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataforma Qualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria Software de gestão de construção que serve como sua única fonte de verdade para cada projeto.
Saiba como o Autodesk Construction Cloud pode ajudar suas equipes a colaborar com segurança e rapidez em todas as fases do projeto, permitindo entregas dentro do prazo e do orçamento.

title: Video ad expert
description:
Please only apply if you are really a short-form 'video ad' expert level designer.
We're looking for a Video Ad Creative Expert who knows how to turn ideas into high-performing short-form ads across Tik Tok and Meta (Facebook/Instagram).
This is not a generic editing role. We need someone who understands attention, pacing, hooks, and conversion-driven creative and can execute at a high level using modern tools, motion design, and AI-generated talent (avatars/voice).
Submission of video ads design portfolio REQUIRED to be considered for the position. We expect to see real animation effects (not stock videos with text layovers).

About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.
What You'll Be Doing
• Create short-form video ads (5–30 seconds) optimized for:
-Tik Tok
-Instagram Reels
-Facebook Feed & Stories
• Develop scroll-stopping hooks within the first 1–3 seconds
• Use advanced motion design to increase retention:
-Kinetic typography
-Dynamic text overlays
-Pattern interrupts
-Seamless jump cuts
• Execute clean, high-impact transitions, including:
-Speed ramps
-Zoom cuts
-Match cuts
-Masking transitions
-Flash/whip transitions (used strategically, not overdone)
• Work with AI avatars & voice tools:
-Synthesia, Hey Gen, or similar
-Lip-sync alignment
-Natural pacing and tone
-Avatar scene composition + background styling
• Combine:
-Stock footage
-B-roll
-Screen recordings
-UI overlays
into cohesive, high-converting creatives
• Rapidly produce and iterate on multiple variations per concept
What We're Looking For
• Proven experience creating direct-response video ads (not just content)
• Strong understanding of:
-Hook → Build → Payoff structure
-Watch time & retention mechanics
-Platform-native editing styles (Tik Tok-first)
• Advanced skills in:
-Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects / Cap Cut (or similar)
-Motion graphics & text animation
-Audio syncing, beat matching, and pacing
• Experience with AI video tools (REQUIRED):
AI avatars (Hey Gen, Synthesia, etc.)
AI voiceovers (Eleven Labs or similar)
Basic prompt structuring for consistency • Ability to create:
Fast-paced, engaging edits without looking chaotic

Experience with financial, newsletter, or lead-gen offers
Ability to interpret performance data and iterate based on results Deliverables

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Technical implementation specialist
description:
Why Kodif?
At Kodif, we're transforming how customers interact with e Commerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we're building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey.
Highlights:
Our team comes from Uber, Meta, Stanford, and Walmart. Our CTO built Uber's customer support platform.
We're backed by Bling Capital, SNR (Kevin Mahaffey), and Village Global (backed by Jeff Bezos, Bill Gates, and Reid Hoffman), with $9 M raised to date.
We're trusted by leading e Commerce brands like Dollar Shave Club, Liquid I. V., Trust Wallet, and Alma. Our Culture & Values:
At Kodif, our values guide how we work, what we build, and how we grow together:
Make It Simple – Build systems that are clear, reliable, and scalable.
Superhuman Speed ️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks.
Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features.
Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers.
Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future.
Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview:
The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif's customers to maximize the value of our platform.
The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform.
Responsibilities:
Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals.
Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed.
Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans.
Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams.
Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents.
Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities.
Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention.
Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements:
Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX Saa S).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required).
Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers.
Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools.
Experience with LLM prompting.
Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.g., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have:
Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required).
Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits:
Competitive salary based on location and work experience.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact.
Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in e Commerce. To be considered, please complete this short application form (2–3 minutes): YYr6 UDG4m RB9 SMt9 and then apply here as well.

title: Senior electrical bim engineer
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U. S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.
We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:
Eracore is growing in Brazil, and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U. S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.
Why You'll Enjoy Working at Eracore
Competitive hourly pay
Continuing Education
Sports & Fitness
Fully remote work
Healthy work–life balance
Learning platforms for professional growth
Supportive leadership and mentorship Your Role
Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools. What We're Looking For
4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
Strong understanding of electrical systems
Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
Team-oriented mindset with mentoring experience
Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused
Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.
